# Contributing to Akaiunsan Admin

Internal dashboard — branch from `main`, keep PRs focused, and make sure `pnpm build`, `pnpm lint`, and the test suite pass before requesting review.

UI primitives are adapted from the open-source [shadcn-admin](https://github.com/satnaing/shadcn-admin) template; when updating them via the shadcn CLI, preserve the local RTL and styling modifications (see README).
